definitions.explanation: Vegetables that have been briefly pickled, typically for just a few hours to a day, in salt, vinegar, or a light brine. Retains a fresh, crunchy texture compared to longer-fermented pickles.

examples.japanese: きゅうり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浅漬|あさづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

{浅漬|あさづ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: Quick pickles are easy to make, so they're perfect for everyday meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浅漬|あさづ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゆず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Adding yuzu peel to lightly pickled napa cabbage gives it a nice aroma.

notes:
USAGE:
A type of ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧ (pickles) characterized by short pickling time and light seasoning. Unlike deeply fermented pickles such as ⟦{沢庵|たくあん}→沢庵：13302_takuan⟧ or ⟦{糠漬|ぬかづ}け→糠漬け：17712_nukazuke⟧, {浅漬|あさづ}け preserves the vegetable's fresh color and crunch. Common vegetables used include ⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧ (napa cabbage), きゅうり (cucumber), {茄子|なす} (eggplant), and ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ (daikon).

The name literally means "shallow/light pickling," contrasting with {古漬|ふるづ}け (long-fermented pickles).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- きゅうり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浅漬|あさづ}け: lightly pickled cucumber
- ⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{浅漬|あさづ}け: lightly pickled napa cabbage
- {浅漬|あさづ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素|もと}→素：28734_moto⟧: quick pickle seasoning mix
- {浅漬|あさづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make quick pickles
